sounds.text: Three very quick rising tiny clock ticks, like a small pocket watch being fast-forwarded, crisp and light.

Sad dark game-over sting for a cute ghost-story mobile game: a slow low diminished string chord swells and sinks while a small music box melody winds down, slows and stops, fading into a cold empty reverb. Eerie and heavy but not scary. No speech, no vocals.
A single soft low bronze bell toll, gentle and somber, ringing out slowly with a long fading tail.
Small distant sparkling 'shing': a quick bright glassy ping followed by a tiny high chime, light and airy, much smaller than a main hit.
An attack swings through empty air and misses: a very fast thin high whoosh with a faint airy hiss at the start, nothing lands.
An old apartment elevator arrives: a clear bright 'ding' of the elevator bell, then two soft mellow chime tones, slightly hollow and lonely as if in an empty lobby.

sounds.ko: 사무실 층 시작 — 형광등 깜빡 + 먼 전화벨
sounds.text: A fluorescent ceiling light flickers on with three sharp electric ticks and a low buzzing hum, then an old desk telephone rings briefly far down an empty office.

sounds.ko: 폐병동 층 시작 — 심전도 삑 ×2 + 물방울
sounds.text: Two slow clean beeps of an old hospital heart monitor in an abandoned ward, then a single water drop falls into a puddle with a hollow plink.

sounds.ko: 옥상·이계 층 시작 — 바람 + 먼 끼익
sounds.text: A cold gust of wind rises across a high rooftop at night, and a rusty metal door or railing creaks faintly in the distance.

sounds.ko: 새 구역 첫 층 (괴담 한 줄 앞) — 거꾸로 부풂
sounds.text: Eerie reversed swell: a soft breathy reverse cymbal and hollow air that grows slowly louder and cuts off suddenly at the peak, like something drawing in a breath.

Short bright victory jingle for beating a boss in a cute ghost-story mobile game: a quick three-note upward chiptune run landing on a bright square-wave major chord with a short snare roll and one cymbal splash. Punchy and happy, about two seconds. No speech, no vocals.
One short clean clock tick, a small dry wooden tock.

sounds.ko: 남은 시간 5초 이하 — 더 급한 틱
sounds.text: One short sharp urgent tick, a higher brighter metallic tick of a clock, tense.
A crisp short click of a fingernail tapping a wooden table, one single tap. Single isolated user-interface sound, dry, no music.
Positive confirm button: two quick soft rising glassy blips, clean and friendly.
Back button: two quick soft falling glassy blips, gentle and neutral.
Start button: a bright bouncy two-step pop going up, with a quick rising airy whoosh, eager and lively.
Selecting a card: one short soft bright wooden tock with a tiny clear ping. Loud, close-up and clearly audible, the sound starts immediately at full volume with no silence before it.
Deselecting a card: one short soft lower duller wooden tock.
Error refusal: two very short low dull buzzes in quick succession, 'bzz-bzz', soft and not harsh.

sounds.ko: 포기 첫 누름 (한 번 더 확인) · 원정 중 잠긴 장비 / 파티를 누름 (안 돼요)
sounds.text: A short clear 'not allowed / are you sure' warning: two quick firm low muted wooden-and-buzzer knocks, a polite error blip that is full-bodied and clearly audible, not harsh.
Happy notification: two quick bright bell pings going up, light and cheerful.
Caution notification: one short low soft blip that dips slightly downward.
Info notification: one tiny short high soft blip, very small.
Picking up a small pet card: a light paper slide with a soft click, then a tiny cute squeaky chirp on top.
Cancel: a paper card slides back into a hand with a soft gentle falling swish.
A single quick paper page flip, light and crisp.
Pause: a soft short airy whoosh that becomes muffled and sinks downward, like sound going under a blanket.
Resume: a soft short airy whoosh that opens up from muffled to bright, rising upward.
Pressing a big power button: a heavy solid click followed by a deep short boomy thump, weighty and satisfying.
A loud short low buzzer error tone, 'bzzt', a dull square-wave buzz with a quick downward bend: clearly says 'not ready yet'. Full volume, no silence.
One small bright golden bell 'ting' with a short sparkle, light and inviting.

sounds.ko: 층 보상 화면 열림 — 카드 3장 뒤집기
sounds.text: Three paper cards flip over quickly one after another, flick flick flick, then one soft bright chime.
Choosing a plain reward card: a crisp paper card tap and click with one small clean chime.
Choosing a rare reward: a cool shimmering crystal glass sparkle chord with a quick run of high icy twinkles, clear and pleasing.
Choosing an epic reward: a rising mystical airy whoosh blooming into a rich warm shimmering magical swell, then a few bright coins clink.

sounds.ko: 보상 고름 (전설) — 금빛 상승 + 큰 종 + 동전 비
sounds.text: Choosing a legendary reward: a short rising magical riser that lands on a big golden bell strike with a soft cymbal shimmer, followed by a bright cascade of gold coins spilling and sparkling.
A quick riffle of paper cards being shuffled, a fast rising whoosh, then one small bright chime.
A rubber stamp thumps down firmly with a solid click and low thud, then four quick rising glassy notes sparkle up into a clear ringing bell.

sounds.ko: 보상 효과 발동 (전투 중, 아주 작게)
sounds.text: A tiny quick double sparkle ping, high and light, very small.
Obtaining an ancient relic: one heavy old bronze temple bell strike with a deep rich ring, then a short run of high golden sparkles over it. Precious and slightly mysterious.
A single small high bronze chime, quick and clear, with a tiny shimmer.

sounds.ko: 결과 화면 최고 기록 칸 (여러 번 울림)
sounds.text: One tiny bright digital score blip jumping up in pitch, like a counter ticking up, quick and clean.

Triumphant final victory fanfare for a cute ghost-story mobile game: a rolling snare build and bright brass playing a rising melody that opens into a big warm major chord with a cymbal crash, ringing bells and chiptune sparkles, joyful and celebratory, ending with a faint eerie twinkle. No speech, no vocals.

Sad defeat sting for a cute ghost-story mobile game: four soft falling minor notes on a mellow mallet, then two deep low bells toll slowly and fade into a cold hollow reverb. Melancholy and eerie, not scary. No speech, no vocals.
Someone joins: two quick soft rising electronic blips, friendly.
Someone leaves: two quick soft falling electronic blips.
Connection lost: two short soft electronic tones stepping down, with a faint crackle of static.
Connection restored: a short burst of soft static clears into two clean electronic tones stepping up, relieved.
Three quick tiny rising robotic beeps, cute little computer chirps.

sounds.ko: 원정 장비 장착 (등급 높을수록 높은 음)
sounds.text: Equipping gear: a crisp metal buckle snaps shut with a click, then a short resonant metallic shimmer and one bright chime ring out.
An item pops out of a bag and is revealed: a quick rising airy swish ending in a bright sparkling chime ping.
A rare relic is revealed: a warm old bronze bell strike, a short climbing run of glittering high twinkles, and a few gold coins clinking.
Safely securing the loot: a leather pouch is drawn shut with a satisfying cinch, coins jingle inside, and a bright rising sparkle swish finishes it. Relieved and happy.
Losing the loot bag: a cloth bag tears and falls with a muffled rustle, small glass trinkets shatter and scatter, then a sad soft tone slides downward and fades.
